description:
COMP3540 Game Prototype Submission - U7287889

In Timber Trail, you play as a lumberjack in a fast-paced, "hill-climb" style game. You face a lumberjack's worst nightmare as you traverse a dangerous mountain slope, trying to reach the finish line while dodging logs and stumps rolling down at high speed. It's no easy trek, as the logs roll much faster than the lumberjack can climb. To make matters worse, getting hit by a log or a stump will set you back or even knock you off the mountain! Dodge your way through the obstacles in two challenging levels to prove you're the boss.
